_comment: LICENCE: Hunyuan3D 2.1 is under the Tencent Hunyuan Community License, whose grant excludes the EU, UK and South Korea and calls use of the outputs there unlicensed. Kept deliberately for its mesh quality — see the Licensing section of README.md. For an asset shipping worldwide use img2mesh_triposg.json (MIT).  AUTO_CLEANUP IS FALSE ON PURPOSE: with it true the ShapeGen node frees the pipeline after the run, but ComfyUI caches the loader node's output — so the FIRST run succeeds and every later one dies with "'Hunyuan3DDiTFlowMatchingPipeline' object has no attribute 'scheduler'" on the gutted cached object. Keeping the pipeline resident costs VRAM; ComfyUI evicts it when it needs to.
